children: Vytis Reno Loans 2025-1 DAC (the Issuer) informs that the audit of its annual financial statements is still ongoing and that additional time is required to complete the remaining audit testing and review procedures. Therefore, the audited annual financial statements were not published by the previously announced date of 15 November 2026.
Based on the latest information available, the audited annual financial statements are expected to be published by 11 December 2026.

title: Revised date for publication of the audited annual financial statements
